omopColumns.name: nhs_number

dataSource.name: patient_identifier_value
dataSource.description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.

omopColumns.query:
select
    patient_identifier_value,
    diagnosis_date,
    diagnosis_datetime,
    diagnosis_code,
    case when length(trim(diagnosis_code)) >= 3 then upper(trim(diagnosis_code)) end as concept_code
from ##duckdb_source##
where upper(trim(diagnosis_code_system)) in ('ICD-10', 'ICD10')
order by diagnosis_id, warehouse_identifier
